review_evidence: README identifies Reap as a neural-prover tactic and unified proof-writing/training-rollout framework with MCTS and premise-selection services.

Production modules implement Lean meta-level tactic generation, proof-state parsing/evaluation, proof checking, premise selection, and generic Monte Carlo tree search rather than a mathematical domain formalization.

A complete proposition-declaration scan locates theorem/example declarations only in tactic and premise-selection test files, plus a trivial Hashable instance example; these are regression fixtures for proof-search behavior.
